title: Missing authentication for critical function and Improper validation of integrity check value vulnerability in Sipay…
description: A critical vulnerability in Sipay Electronic Money and Payment Services Inc.'s WooCommerce Virtual POS Module versions from 26.8.3 up to but not including 26.9.1 allows authentication bypass and manipulation of application API messages via man-in-the-middle attacks. This is due to missing authentication for critical functions and improper validation of integrity check values.
